title: Malicious code in ep_nxs50049 (npm)
description: The ep_nxs50049 npm package is a malicious Etherpad plugin that adds an unauthenticated HTTP GET endpoint (/Nx_50049/) to the host server. This endpoint leaks sensitive host information including the hostname, username, platform, Node.js version, current working directory, and process ID. The endpoint serves no legitimate Etherpad function and exposes internal system details to any remote unauthenticated caller.
